name: use-step
title: useStep

types.name: UseStepActions
types.description: Represents the second element of the output of the `useStep` hook.

properties.description: Go to the next step in the process.

properties.name: goToPrevStep
properties.description: Go to the previous step in the process.

properties.description: Reset the step to the initial step.

returnType.name: [number, UseStepActions]
